integrity: The support-two identity and support-three endpoint formulas are algebraic. Exact rational replay checks the displayed witness and a supplementary finite integer benchmark; literature comparison explicitly treats general Gini–Pietra ordering disagreement as prior work.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns equally weighted finite nonnegative income populations. Weighted observations, negative incomes, and higher-support classifications are outside scope.
title: Three households are the sharp Gini–Pietra ranking split
